problem_summary: 8 citizen complaints about 'Fixing/Reparing Potholes' were recorded in HMT between May 2019 and February 2022, spanning 4 calendar year(s). 62% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened).

agency_attribution_note: 8 of 8 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
